item.title: Nancy Guthrie: DNA profile found on glove did not match anyone in CODIS system
item.description: DNA from a glove that was found two miles from Nancy Guthrie's home did not match anyone in the CODIS system, Pima County Sheriff Chris Nanos told FOX 10.After the glove was found, it was sent to Florida for testing. The glove was then sent back to Arizona to be re-tested before it was entered into CODIS.DNA from the glove also didn't match any found at Guthrie's home.
